name: Izumi Shikibu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 56); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 10th century.

poems.title: My life is drawing to a close
poems.author: Izumi Shikibu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 56
poems.text:
My life is drawing to a close,
I cannot longer stay,
A pleasant memory of thee
I fain would take away;
So visit me, I pray.
